candidates.change_summary: Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val + 1;` so stored value differs.
Delete the `if(intitalized)revert();` check, allowing MinSum to be changed after initialization.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = _val * 2;` so stored value differs.
Insert `MinSum = _val - 1;` after the existing assignment to overwrite with a different value.
Remove the initialized check so MinSum can be changed repeatedly.
Always revert, making it impossible to ever change MinSum from its default zero.
Set MinSum to a hardcoded value instead of the argument, so the caller's _val is ignored.
Delete the assignment so MinSum stays at its default zero regardless of the call.
Add _val to current MinSum instead of overwriting it, so repeated calls accumulate.
Remove the revert when intitalized is true, allowing LogFile to be changed after initialization.
Remove the intitalized guard entirely, unconditionally setting LogFile.
Change the revert condition to always revert, making LogFile permanently unchangeable.
Remove the assignment of LogFile, so the state variable never updates.
Delete the line 'acc.balance += msg.value;' so the contract balance does not increase upon Put.
Change 'acc.balance += msg.value;' to 'acc.balance += msg.value + 1;' so the stored balance is always one greater than the actual contributed amount.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so the Log contract's History and LastMsg are not updated on Put.
Delete the require statement so overflow/underflow protection is removed and Put can proceed even with overflow.
Replace 'block.timestamp+_lockTime' with '_lockTime' in the unlock time update condition and assignment so unlock time is set incorrectly.
Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance = msg.value;' so balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
